name: Do I need permits for major kitchen storage renovations in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for major kitchen storage renovations in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether permits are needed depends on the scope of the storage renovation. Minor changes like installing new drawer organizers or pull-out shelves typically do not require permits. However, if the renovation involves altering the kitchen's layout significantly, moving walls, changing plumbing or electrical systems, or structural modifications, then permits from the City of Daly City Planning and Building Department will likely be required. It's always best to consult with your contractor or local building department.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are usually not needed for minor storage upgrades. However, if the renovation involves significant layout changes, or altering plumbing/electrical, permits from Daly City are likely required.
